input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is the APPROVED COVENANT CREATURE SOURCE, the authority for anatomy, palette and painting style. Use BOTH references visually. Match its lighter stylized painted values and simple sculpted shapes exactly; do not darken into realistic horror, add photoreal skin or fur, or add black shadows. Reference-1 is an A10 master or a crop of that approved source. Generate the requested anatomical view even if the reference is a rear view. This is an ANIMAL ONLY. No human body, no clothes, no weapon or staff, no hands. Keep its exact creature anatomy. Raw magical broad squat amphibian-like bog creature, four short splayed legs, heavy moss-green stone hide, broad round mouth, luminous turquoise throat sac, root tendrils and wet mist. Chunky artillery silhouette; intact non-gory creature. FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally TOWARD viewer and image RIGHT, face and front surfaces clearly visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly FOUR columns by FOUR rows, SIXTEEN complete isolated poses. Keys 1-4: four subtle ready IDLE poses with breathing and small natural shifts. Keys 5-10: Six distinct natural frog hopping keys: crouch; hind legs extend to push; body travels forward legs extended; legs tuck under airborne body; front feet contact; hind feet settle into crouch. No human running. Keys 11-16: six ATTACK poses, ready, turquoise throat inflates, head draws back, mouth opens to project forward, throat deflates, ready recovery; no projectile in this body sheet. All complete bodies same anatomical scale, very wide empty magenta gutters. No labels, no text, no anatomy outside its cell. No falling or resting poses. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only. CORRECTION: Keep the FRONT-RIGHT view of Reference-1 for every key, including hopping: front chest, throat sac and face toward viewer-right. Never copy the rear-facing posture from Reference-2. RUN keys must form one natural frog hop: crouch, both hind legs extend in push, airborne extended, airborne tucked, front-paw landing, settle. ATTACK has open mouth and inflated then deflated throat, but absolutely NO projectile, spray, mist cloud or detached magic outside the body. Sixteen clean small isolated keys.

arguments.Prompt: A 4x4 animation sprite sheet with exactly 16 complete isolated poses arranged in a clean 4 by 4 grid on an absolute flat solid vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF background. Hand-painted digital dark fantasy game concept art style, lighter stylized painted values, simple sculpted shapes, smooth opaque paint, cool upper-left light with small grounded contact shadows. Creature identity: Mire Maw, broad squat amphibian bog creature with heavy moss-green stone hide, four short splayed legs, broad round mouth, luminous turquoise throat sac, and subtle root tendrils. Pure animal creature, intact non-gory body. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic. In EVERY single pose, the creature is strictly in FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter view, head, chest, turquoise throat sac, and face angled diagonally toward the viewer and to the right. Cell layout (16 poses): Keys 1-4 (Row 1): 4 subtle ready idle breathing keys. Keys 5-10 (Row 2 and start of Row 3): 6 natural frog hopping keys facing front-right (crouch, hind legs extend pushing off, airborne body extended, airborne legs tucked, front paws landing, hind feet settling). Keys 11-16 (rest of Row 3 and Row 4): 6 attack keys facing front-right (anticipation, turquoise throat sac inflating, head pulling back, mouth gaping wide open to project forward, throat deflating, recovery). Absolutely NO projectile, spell, or mist outside the body. All 16 figures at identical anatomical scale, completely inside the middle 60% of each cell, separated by wide empty pure magenta gutters. No text, no grid lines, no borders, no labels.
